blocks.text: TANTANGAN, South Cotabato — A P50 million district hospital will rise in Tantangan, South Cotabato, bringing health and medical services closer to residents and nearby communities. Officials held a groundbreaking ceremony for the Tantangan District Hospital on Monday. It will rise in Purok Upper Maligaya, Barangay Poblacion, with the Melco Foundation, the corporate social responsibility arm of City of Dreams Manila, providing P50 million for the project.
